observations: Photo 0 shows a large flat-screen TV with a bright display showing a Samsung QLED 50Q60T promotional image. The screen has a thin bezel, and the Samsung logo is visible in the top right corner. The TV is on a stand with two black legs. In front of the TV, there is a yellow box with a remote, power cable, and other accessories. The background includes stacked plastic water bottles and a white wall.

Photo 1 shows the same TV with a different screen display: a smart TV interface with app icons (Netflix, Showmax, YouTube, etc.) and a 'Continue Watching' section. The bezel appears consistent with photo 0. The same accessories are visible on the yellow box in front.

Photo 2 shows the TV with a blue background image of a person in an orange top and blue leggings. The left side of the screen shows a partial view of the same promotional text as in photo 0, including 'QLED' and '60T'. The TV stand and accessories are unchanged.
The screen is turned on in all photos, showing vibrant colors and clear images. The TV appears to be in a home or storage environment, not a showroom.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 screen clearly shows 'SAMSUNG QLED 50Q60T' and 'QUANTUM HDR', which matches the model and 4K QLED description. The year 2020 is not visible in photos but is a known release year for this model; the claim is unverifiable_remote for the year, but the model is confirmed.

The bezel appears very thin, but 'bezel-less' is a marketing term. The photos show a visible bezel, especially on the sides and bottom. No close-up of the bezel edge is provided to confirm if it is truly bezel-less. The term is subjective and not fully verifiable from current photos.
The TV has a modern design with a slim profile and stand. The smart interface shown in photo 1 confirms it is a smart TV with app support.

risks.risk: Physical damage or screen defects (dead pixels, burn-in, cracks)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen from multiple angles, especially under direct light, and a video showing screen uniformity and motion.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective; buyer assumes risk of screen issues.

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional accessories (remote, HDMI cables, power adapter)
risks.proof: Clear photos of all accessories with labels and close-ups of connectors, and a video showing the remote working with the TV.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as accessories may be missing or non-functional; buyer assumes risk.

risks.risk: TV not in working condition or has software issues
risks.proof: Video showing the TV powering on, navigating menus, playing content, and switching inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working; buyer assumes risk of non-functionality.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the screen edges to verify bezel thickness and check for damage or dead pixels.
Video showing the TV turning on, navigating the interface, and playing a video.
Photos of all accessories with labels and connectors clearly visible.
Photo of the TV's back panel showing ports and model label (if any).
response.reason: The model is confirmed as Samsung Q60T from the screen display, but critical risks remain unproven: screen condition, functionality, and accessory completeness. Without proof of these, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant risk. The seller's claims are mostly supported, but the 'bezel-less' claim is unverified and subjective. Proof is needed to move to pricing.
